event.title: Flávio Bolsonaro and Family Granted US Visas After Election Loss and Fleeing Brazil
event.canonical_title: Flávio Bolsonaro and Family Granted US Visas After Election Loss and Fleeing Brazil
event.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, and his family have arrived in Miami after fleeing Brazil. This move follows his refusal to concede defeat to incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and a court order that barred him from leaving the country due to ongoing investigations into money laundering and other allegations. The US State Department has granted them entry visas amid these developments.

key_facts: Flávio Bolsonaro lost the presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
He fled Brazil shortly after the election results were announced.
Bolsonaro and his family landed in Miami, Florida.
The US State Department granted them visas despite ongoing legal issues in Brazil.
